board_summary.disposition_reason: Board REJECTED: Contains 4 critical P1 defect(s) violating IPC-A-600 Class 2/3 criteria. Severe functional circuit failure or hazardous electrical bridge detected.

board_level_intelligence.acceptance_rationale: The PCB was determined as 'REJECT' based on unified scoring where critical functional defects violate IPC-A-600 Class 2/3 criteria. Immediate quarantine is mandated.
major_risks: Complete trace discontinuity (open circuit) causing total signal loss or floating gate behavior.
Trace bottlenecking from mousebites induces localized current crowding and thermal stress hotspots.
Dielectric clearance erosion from copper spurs elevates risk of localized dielectric breakdown or solder bridging.
immediate_priorities: Defect #4 (OPEN - P1_CRITICAL): Immediate optical isolation and rework evaluation.
Defect #1 (MOUSEBITE - P1_CRITICAL): Immediate optical isolation and rework evaluation.
Defect #2 (SPUR - P1_CRITICAL): Immediate optical isolation and rework evaluation.

individual_defect_intelligence.what_was_detected: Detected Open Circuit anomaly at coordinates [315.7, 432.8, 374.3, 465.4] with 77.8% optical model confidence.
individual_defect_intelligence.why_significant: IPC-A-600 Class 2/3 violation: A complete physical discontinuity or break along a conductive copper trace or via pad, interrupting electrical connection.. Evaluated with CERI geometric risk score of 1.00 and Unified Priority P1_CRITICAL.
potential_consequences: Loss of signal continuity across the net, causing functional circuit failure.
Disconnected power rail or floating high-impedance logic input.
Intermittent operation under thermal expansion and mechanical vibration.
CEIA Proxy: Nodal conductance factor G=0.0 (J = 0.0 A·m⁻²). Complete circuit open with zero current transfer.
region_inspection_points: Position stereo microscope directly over bounding coordinates [315.7, 432.8, 374.3, 465.4] under 20x-30x magnification.
Use oblique ring-lighting to inspect conductor sidewalls, looking for copper lifting, undercut, or burrs.
Overlay Gerber reference net to confirm original intended conductor boundaries.
individual_defect_intelligence.suggested_corrective_action: For high-reliability Class 3 assemblies, scrap board or submit to Material Review Board (MRB). For Class 2 rework: solder an approved 30 AWG insulated micro-jumper wire between net testpoints or via pads.
verification_protocol: Perform 2-point electrical continuity check using a calibrated digital multimeter (DMM) across net endpoints (< 0.5 Ohm).
Inspect jumper solder joints under 20x magnification for wetting, meniscus, and solder cleanliness.
Apply IPC-CC-830 conformal coating spot-repair over the reworked trace.

individual_defect_intelligence.what_was_detected: Detected Mouse Bite anomaly at coordinates [240.1, 335.7, 271.6, 370.9] with 87.5% optical model confidence.
individual_defect_intelligence.why_significant: IPC-A-600 Class 2/3 violation: A notch, tear, or void along the edge of a copper conductor trace, reducing the effective cross-sectional conductor width.. Evaluated with CERI geometric risk score of 0.97 and Unified Priority P1_CRITICAL.
potential_consequences: Localized current crowding and increased trace resistance at the bottleneck.
Elevated localized temperature rise (hotspot) under rated current load.
Vulnerability to fatigue fracture during thermal cycling or mechanical shock.
CERI & CEIA Proxies: 95.0% trace width necking elevates localized current density to 2.25 × 10⁹ A·m⁻² (20.0x crowding vs nominal J₀), risking severe Joule heating and thermal stress hotspots.
region_inspection_points: Position stereo microscope directly over bounding coordinates [240.1, 335.7, 271.6, 370.9] under 20x-30x magnification.
Use oblique ring-lighting to inspect conductor sidewalls, looking for copper lifting, undercut, or burrs.
Overlay Gerber reference net to confirm original intended conductor boundaries.
individual_defect_intelligence.suggested_corrective_action: Evaluate remaining trace width against DRC specification (95.0% reduction). If remaining width meets minimum current-carrying capacity, accept with engineering note. Otherwise, apply copper foil micro-patch or bridge with micro-wire.
verification_protocol: Measure narrowest conductor bottleneck width using calibrated optical reticle microscope.
Conduct Kelvin 4-wire trace resistance measurement to verify resistance within 5% of nominal trace.

individual_defect_intelligence.what_was_detected: Detected Spur anomaly at coordinates [444.1, 299.6, 480.8, 333.0] with 83.5% optical model confidence.
individual_defect_intelligence.why_significant: IPC-A-600 Class 2/3 violation: An unwanted sharp or irregular copper protrusion extending outward from a trace boundary into the adjacent dielectric spacing.. Evaluated with CERI geometric risk score of 0.97 and Unified Priority P1_CRITICAL.
potential_consequences: Severe reduction of dielectric clearance distance to adjacent conductors.
Risk of electrical arc or dielectric breakdown during high-voltage transient events.
Potential trap for solder bridge formation during wave or reflow soldering.
CERI Proxy: 95.0% dielectric clearance reduction (0.01 mm remaining) increases susceptibility to localized capacitive cross-talk and transient dielectric breakdown.
region_inspection_points: Position stereo microscope directly over bounding coordinates [444.1, 299.6, 480.8, 333.0] under 20x-30x magnification.
Use oblique ring-lighting to inspect conductor sidewalls, looking for copper lifting, undercut, or burrs.
Overlay Gerber reference net to confirm original intended conductor boundaries.
individual_defect_intelligence.suggested_corrective_action: Evaluate clearance against IPC-A-600 minimum spacing. If out of specification, micro-trim the copper protrusion using an approved diamond-tipped dental micro-scraper under 20x stereo magnification.
verification_protocol: Measure post-trim dielectric clearance with optical measuring microscope (must exceed minimum spacing rule).
Inspect substrate for mechanical damage or delamination.

recommended_investigations: Audit chemical etchant concentration (CuCl2 / H2O2) and monitor conveyor belt feed speed.
